purpose: Diagnose production r39 circulation against external pressure-level reanalysis before selecting another rainfall intervention. No parameter fitting or adoption.
reference: NOAA PSL NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis1 1981-2010 monthly means, native 2.5-degree pressure grid. Reuse hash-verified V10 California/Iberia sources; acquire only missing regional subsets. No reference field enters the climate integration.
control: Four integrations must reproduce original float32 equal-month T/P/observations and derived geography, with strict numerical checks. Save actual diagnostic monthly wind components and projected-coordinate geometry. Gregorian overlap is used only to match reference wind months; legacy climate accuracy remains measured under the unchanged legacy definition.
comparison: Transform modeled right/up components to geographic east/north using the full azimuthal-equidistant projection Jacobian. Undo southern north/south reflection and preserve July-through-June reference order. Aggregate model vectors to native reference footprints by true area; score only footprints at least80% covered by the inmap rectangle. Exclude mixed coast cells (20-80% model land). Require every month's925hPa geopotential height above maximum model mean terrain in the footprint, with nonnegative925hPa height. Report native-cell counts and physical area, not fine cells as independent observations.
targets: Compare925hPa and850hPa monthly mean vectors separately, plus q-weighted925-300hPa mean wind from trapezoidal integration of q and qU over actual shared levels. Specific humidity q is recovered from the legacy reader's mixing ratio r=q/(1-q). This is a partial column and product of monthly means: it excludes transient q'u' flux, air below925hPa/above300hPa, and native reanalysis below-ground flags unavailable in these products. Terrain masking is conservative relative to model geography, not proof of native terrain validity. A surface-like single-layer model cannot be expected to match all pressure targets.
decision: Diagnostic only. Do not select parameters, relabel wind differences as rainfall gains, replace r39/r38, change fantasy atlases, or infer global skill from these reused four regions. Use signs, seasonality and land/ocean differences to design a separately declared physical intervention. Reference1981-2010 differs from the WorldClim1970-2000 rain period. Reanalysis is model-assisted rather than independent point observations.
